title: A village at your fingertips
subtitle: Choose a place. Shape its work. See the season change.

ui.paid: Materials paid once · crews work each season
ui.refund: Unused materials returned: {wood} timber, {blanks} prepared sets
ui.maintenance: One adult and one timber repair the weakest enabled place when allocated.
ui.access_note: One adult and one timber each season support the outer connection.
ui.inspect_note: Observation records knowledge. It creates no supplies or completed work.
ui.growth_note: Choose a route. Cards show real prerequisites and competing uses of the same ground.
ui.new_note: 30 residents · 100 provisions · 30 timber. Living rules; incidents remain an explicit choice.
ui.overwrite: Start a new village? Your saved village stays untouched until you choose Save.
ui.legacy: This save retains its existing rules. Adopt later chapters from the detailed ledger when ready.
ui.incident_note: Adds two bounded incidents to this living save. First guaranteed warning arrives after six seasons; no immediate damage.
ui.restriction_note: Fewer productive workers at the affected place; reduce exposure. Revisable before resolution.
ui.no_knowledge: Ask at the place to add available findings to your planning record.
ui.report_note: Actual results of the last resolved season.
ui.preview_note: Expected effects with current orders. Your later decisions can change them.
ui.help_keys: Click buildings or their icons · right-drag to look · WASD to move · Tab for mouse look
ui.model_empty: No existing building on this site. View the place in the village.
ui.guide_setup: New village starts household, asset, land and living rules. For an older save, adopt missing chapters in that order. City lifecycle then offers explicit town development; village warfare needs Living village but does not require civic adoption. Recurring threats are a separate opt-in. Opening this guide or a review spends nothing and adopts nothing.

living_orders.label: Woodland
living_orders.detail: The same timber crew uses one finite woodland. Northern support reduces access losses.

living_orders.label: Prepare materials
living_orders.detail: Ordinary: 1 adult + 2 timber → 1 set. Shared: 2 adults + 3 timber + 2 working places; needs shared wood work.

living_orders.label: Support cooperation
living_orders.detail: Requires discovered complementary practice and actual shared sessions. Continuing support costs timber and labor.

living_orders.label: Observation focus
living_orders.detail: Coverage follows this place. Northern access needs its post and two ordinary watch adults.

living_orders.label: Watch practice
living_orders.detail: One additional adult trains with existing equipment; that adult cannot gather or build.

living_orders.label: Maintain equipment
living_orders.detail: One adult + one opening timber + one opening prepared set restore one missing kit, up to four.

chains.note: Keep short paths. Homes replace shared working ground; adapting the room restores space.
Keep central workspaces. Build and maintain the northern connection.
Food, storage and working space support further growth. These are complementary investments, not prerequisite steps.
Shelter enables equipment. The northern post is an independent choice of coverage.

lessons.title: Keep the village fed
lessons.body: Choose Stores, then its reserve objective. Two or three seasons give extra gathering priority over timber and ordinary projects; one season leaves it later. The top strip shows supplies now and expected seasonal change. Choose a buffer while leaving adults for the next paid project.

lessons.title: Choose an improvement
lessons.body: Click an illustrated improvement. Review timber, work and requirements, then commission it. Materials are paid once; work happens only when you resolve a season.

lessons.title: Leave hands for the work
lessons.body: Projects share adults with food, care, watch and preparation. The Work underway view lets you change crew limits, pause or cancel unfinished work.

lessons.title: Choose where to grow
lessons.body: Open the Growth guide. Compact homes consume central workspaces; outer homes need a maintained path. Inspect a card and visit its actual site before paying.

lessons.title: Prepare, resolve, recover
lessons.body: Maintain posts and equipment, then start the optional preparedness chapter. Warning and recovery appear at the affected place. Save whenever you want; looking around never advances time.

lessons.title: Practice, sustain, then pay
lessons.body: City lifecycle shows the next civic requirements and qualifying seasons. Wood shaping comes from actual material preparation or equipment repair, not the illustrative learning-circle score. If prepared sets are full, preparation pauses: spend them on equipment or repairs. Meet the named factors, sustain them through resolved seasons, then commission the assembly shelter. Timber is paid once and finite crews complete the work; promotion grants no free buildings.

lessons.title: Keep achievement and support distinct
lessons.body: The completed shelter earns Large village. Enable town development explicitly, sustain current Town support, then pay to adapt that same shelter into a civic house. Earned rank and paid fabric remain through shortages; current Town support can fall and recover. Town is the highest playable civic stage. Large town and later ranks remain planned.

lessons.title: Keep town services working
lessons.body: The civic house replaces one civic adult with two; its later allocation priority means timber or projects can leave it unstaffed. The review shows actual staffing and condition. Optional preparation helps supply watch kits and repairs while sets are needed. Provision service protects actual spoilage; full stores may turn that saving into overflow. Pause optional work or reduce its crew to restore services. Civic and service adults also contribute the separately named social factors.

lessons.title: Prepare residents and their ground
lessons.body: Enable village warfare deliberately. Build a watch shelter, prepare wooden sets, pay for kits and allow actual watch practice. Additional home watch requests real residents and competes with construction and timber; it grants no people or equipment. Paid woven screens shape routes but keep entrances open and need maintained watch assets. Save assembly, important places and fallback positions before mobilization. Practice on a copy leaves village life unchanged.

lessons.title: Choose how to meet a warning
lessons.body: Recurring threats are optional and give preparation time: protect the stores, stop landing thieves or deny the northern approach. Command personally begins paused deployment; Delegate command uses the same valid orders; Resolve quickly batches the same battle rules. You can take command back, or stop quick resolution at a coherent paused state. Select, then right-click an order; Space pauses, V selects the close view and 0 returns overhead. Camera gestures do not issue orders.

lessons.title: Accept, recover and continue
lessons.body: An ended encounter waits for acceptance. Read named participation, injuries, supplies and equipment consequences, then accept once. Battle aftermath remains available from village life. Keep food available, staff finite treatment care, prepare sets and enable ordinary kit repair. Release additional watch to free adults for paid work. Incapacitation is recoverable; further threats wait for recovery. This village has no army recruitment or conquest; those remain future connections.
